searchText: These are very good suggestions! I think a researcher/dev might do a better job at it than me, though. Seems like something Justin Drake could do well 🙂 (I sent him a screenshot of this chat!) Merge => verkle trees => state expiry => regenisis => sharding? ZK blocks? The target isn't either gas price or throughput. It is long term health and security. Gas limits (throughput) is set as high as possible without sacrificing those. Guys anybody can help me understand node recovery mechanism of ethereum ? Let's say a node goes down , and now when it comes online and wants to resync with the network. To how many nodes does it asks for missing blocks , is there some number ? or some percentage? it only needs 1 it may as multiple to avoid burdening the connection with any single other node but that's just an optimization Thanks
